chunks: If you are instigated by the Devil to evil seek refuge in God, for God hears all and knows everything.
ai.seo_question: What should one do when the Devil instigates evil thoughts?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited as the primary basis for the practice of *isti'adha* (seeking refuge) before reciting the Quran or engaging in worship, highlighting the spiritual vulnerability of the believer to *waswas* (whispers). The emphasis on Allah being *Samī'* (All-Hearing) and *ʿAlīm* (All-Knowing) assures the faithful that their plea for protection is both perceived and understood by the Divine, reinforcing the efficacy of this spiritual defense mechanism.
